name: Neon Night
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: City lights: a soft grey page by day and a deep blue one at night, magenta and blue accents, and a coloured heading ladder with a fading rule. On the Tokyo Night palette.

zh.description: 城市灯火：白天是柔和的灰色页，夜里是深蓝色页，洋红和蓝色点缀，标题按级别着色，分隔线渐隐。基于 Tokyo Night 配色。
